name: White-label tenant portal — shell & login (approval frames)
description: Contract-freeze UX artifacts for the FuzeFront white-label tenant portal: one shell (topbar + side panel + app grid) and one login, reskinned to the active portal's name/logo/accent from GET /api/v1/portal/context, applied entirely through design-system token overrides (no raw hex). Covers loading (no-flash), error, and the fail-closed cases (suspended portal, unknown-host root fallback, cross-portal login rejection) plus light/dark theming. Approving these frames approves the flows, components, DS primitive, and package in `build`. frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against the data-frame / data-* hooks. Per-flow approval — approving portal-shell unblocks that flow independently of portal-login.

dependsOn: FF-EPIC-10-S2: GET /api/v1/portal/context boot endpoint (public/pre-auth) — the contract + @fuzefront/portal-client are authored by contract-designer, not in this frames PR.
FF-EPIC-09: portals.branding jsonb (name/logo/favicon/accent/tagline) + seeded root portal.
FF-EPIC-10-S1/S3: resolvePortalContext fail-closed (suspended 403, unknown-host root fallback) + portal_id JWT binding (cross-portal rejection).
brandingFields: branding.logo (url | null → initials/default fallback, never a broken image)
branding.favicon (url | null → default fallback, cache-busted per portal id)
branding.accent (CSS color → DS token override; AA-contrast-validated, malformed → default)

designSystemPrimitives: BrandTokenScope (applies a validated portal accent as scoped CSS-var overrides layered over base @fuzefront/design-system tokens, with WCAG 2.1 AA contrast fallback + malformed-color rejection) — NET-NEW in @fuzefront/design-system; frontend-engineer is the sole editor of design-system/.
Logo slot primitive (img with initials/default fallback — never a broken-image icon) — add to the base DS if not already present.
consumes: host shell ThemeContext (extended from light/dark-only — not a parallel theming mechanism)

frames.label: Index
frames.summary: Flow walker + build inventory: the two flow cards (portal-shell, portal-login), the ordered 5-frame walk, the components/DS-primitive/package plan mirroring manifest.build 1:1, and the contract binding.
frames.acceptanceNotes: index links to every frame in order; the build inventory mirrors manifest.build exactly; both flow cards resolve to their first screen.

frames.label: Branded tenant shell (CorpABC)
frames.summary: CorpABC portal shell: topbar with tenant logo tile + name, branded search, side panel with active-nav accent, avatar, and the portal app grid. Every accent surface resolves to the CorpABC brand token via [data-portal='corpabc'].
frames.acceptanceNotes: data-portal='corpabc' re-points --accent-* to CorpABC tokens; topbar logo/name come from branding.*; no FuzeFront wordmark anywhere; active nav, avatar, seam, app-icon tints all use var(--accent-color).

frames.label: Root FuzeFront shell
frames.summary: The identical shell markup with data-portal flipped to 'root' — default FuzeFront branding (seam logo, indigo→cyan accent) returns. Proves the reskin is token-only with zero component changes.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Same regions/markup as frame 1; only data-portal='root'; the seam gradient + indigo accent render; demonstrates same shell reskinned by portal context (FF-EPIC-13 goal).

frames.label: White-label login (CorpABC host)
frames.summary: Tenant-branded sign-in served on the portal host (app.corpabc.com): brand pane with logo/name/tagline (custom copy), auth card with email/password, forgot-password, portal SSO, and create-account link. Branded pre-auth from the public portal-context endpoint.
frames.acceptanceNotes: logo/name/accent/copy from branding.*; submit, focus ring, tagline accent, SSO use var(--accent-color)=CorpABC; auth served same-origin by the hidden platform with no FuzeFront wordmark; forgot-password and signup routes present.

frames.label: Light / dark theming
frames.summary: 2×2 matrix (CorpABC/root × dark/light) showing the portal accent layered over both light and dark theme tokens. Theme = [data-theme] surfaces; branding = [data-portal] accent — orthogonal layers, no style forks. Includes the WCAG-AA contrast-fallback guardrail note.
frames.acceptanceNotes: each preview is a self-contained token scope (own data-theme + data-portal); CorpABC blue and root indigo both read correctly on light and dark; semantic status tokens never overridden by branding; contrast guardrail (FF-EPIC-13-S3 AC3/AC4) documented.

frames.label: States (contract)
frames.summary: The five contract states: loading (neutral skeleton, no flash of FuzeFront branding), error+retry (context failed), suspended portal ('this portal is unavailable', 403), unknown-host → root fallback, and cross-portal login rejection ('this account isn't part of CorpABC').
frames.acceptanceNotes: each state addressable by data-state; loading shows no default branding before tenant paints; suspended/unknown-host/cross-portal are fail-closed; error offers retry, never a silent unbranded fallback; cross-portal maps to FF-EPIC-10-S3 token-vs-host mismatch → re-auth.
